Propriety Questions Raised Over Justice SC Sharma's Son's Role

Questions of propriety have arisen concerning Justice S.C. Sharma, whose son appeared in a case involving the Election Commission of India (ECI) and Medha Roopam. The son's appearance in a case heard by his father has led to scrutiny regarding potential conflicts of interest. The case also involves Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar's daughter.
